summary: For encodings requiring numeric character reference replacement, encode_from_utf8 subtracted NCR_EXTRA (9 at this revision) from the destination length without checking for underflow. Short buffers could panic during subtraction or subsequent slicing. The fix returns (OutputFull, 0, 0, false) before subtracting when the buffer is too short; it also applies the same correction to encode_from_utf16. The proposed reversal isolates the UTF-8 correction. Blocked: no detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit. The fix adds no tests, existing encoding test helpers allocate at least 10 bytes, and the high-level encoding API reserves replacement space. No builds or tests were executed.
